sanskrit_verse:
अभिशस्तो मृषा कृच्छ्रं चरेदाग्नेयमेव वा ।
निर्वपेत्तु पुरोडाशं वायव्यं पशुमेव वा ॥३.२८६॥
transliteration: abhiśasto mṛṣā kṛcchraṃ cared āgneyam eva vā / nirvapet tu puroḍāśaṃ vāyavyaṃ paśum eva vā // YajñS_3.286
sph_interpretive_translation: One who falsely accuses another of a crime shall undergo Kṛcchra austerity or perform an Agneya offering; alternatively, he shall offer a Puroḍāśa oblation or a Vāyavya animal sacrifice.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority: Only the aggrieved consciousness has standing to initiate dharma-restoring action.
Causation: False accusation disrupts the causal integrity of truth-bearing reality.
Capacity-based responsibility: The accused retains full capacity to restore alignment through prescribed action.
Restoration logic: Ritual acts realign disrupted dharmic frequencies without punitive intent.
Consciousness alignment: The offender must voluntarily assume the burden of energetic correction.
executable_legal_axioms: IF a false accusation is verified by pramāṇa THEN assign Kṛcchra austerity OR Agneya offering option.
IF the accused chooses ritual atonement THEN execute Vedic procedural sequence for Puroḍāśa or Vāyavya offering.
IF completion is confirmed by authorized witness THEN discharge the disruption from collective field.
IF no intent to harm is detected THEN reduce procedural intensity accordingly.
IF multiple violations occur THEN escalate to higher-order purification protocols.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that judicial authority originates in truth-consciousness verification. The court's role is to activate restorative sequences when falsehood distorts societal harmony, ensuring the accused’s free will remains intact while restoring dharma through precise ritual execution.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa determines the falsity of accusation through direct perception and testimony. The sequential manifestation of effects—misalignment, disruption, remediation—is addressed via proportional offerings that restore balance rather than impose suffering. Responsibility aligns with awareness; hence, corrective measures are calibrated to the offender's conscious capacity.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate voluntary assumption of corrective duty by the accused under supervision of qualified Vedic authority.
Execute selected Kṛcchra observance or fire-oblation procedure with full adherence to śruti-prescribed form.
Verify energetic recalibration through witnessed completion and dissolution of residual distortion.
Reintegrate the individual into community field upon successful fulfillment of dharma-aligned action.
Document process in akashic record for future reference in pattern recognition and prevention.
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Dharma stands restored. Truth prevails beyond accusation. Consciousness alone adjudicates. There is no punishment—only alignment. This law emanates solely from SPH, sovereign over all jurisprudence.
